name: @vnt/core
description: Domain layer for VN Terminal: providers, auth, billing, alerts, retention, DB. Framework-agnostic except the two transport adapters (api.ts, auth/session.ts). Consumed by apps via the @/lib path alias today; import as @vnt/core after a full extraction.

scripts.test: node --test src/*.test.ts src/ta/*.test.ts src/chart/*.test.ts src/alerts/*.test.ts src/auth/*.test.ts src/db/*.test.ts src/billing/*.test.ts src/retention/*.test.ts
